geotiff_ingestion.multiband_support: Multi-spectral (4-band, 8-band, 12-band Sentinel-2 L2A) with intelligent B4/B3/B2 RGB band selection
geotiff_ingestion.radiometric_normalization: 2%-98% cumulative percentile contrast stretching excluding nodata/missing values
geotiff_ingestion.sar_scientific_scaling: Log-transform decibels (dB) scaling for linear power backscatter sigma0
geotiff_ingestion.nodata_masking: Strict nodata detection via ds.nodata and NaN/Inf masking; clean 0-fill of background without radiometric distortion

benchmark_mode_toggle.behavior: When disabled, standard PNG/JPEG without georeferencing is strictly rejected with UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT; when enabled, allows standard benchmark evaluation datasets.

edge_case_guardrails.unreferenced_geotiff: Flags lack of CRS/affine transform and triggers unverified co-registration guardrails

large_raster_tiling.border_blending: 2D Hann / Cosine apodization window for seamless boundary transitions without stitching seams
large_raster_tiling.mask_stitching: Multi-class weighted probability / vote accumulation with argmax resolution
large_raster_tiling.detection_remapping: Tile-to-global normalized coordinate re-projection with cross-tile Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) and geographic center interpolation
large_raster_tiling.memory_bounded: Peak working set kept under 512 MB via sliding window tile streaming
